scripts.build: bunx tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && bun run esbuild.config.mjs production && bun run copy-files
scripts.copy-files: mkdir -p dist && cp manifest.json dist/ && cp LICENSE dist/ && cp styles.css dist/ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.package: bun run build && cd dist && zip -r ../mdbrain-plugin.zip .
scripts.version: bun run version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json

scripts-description.dev: Build and watch to ../vaults/test/.obsidian/plugins/mdbrain for integration testing
